To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

IT outsourcing managers’ decisions are affected by overconfidence, that different types of managers’ knowledge can have contrasting influences on overconfidence, and that knowledge can be a boon or a bane for decision quality.
IT managers’ overconfidence in their IT outsourcing decisions depends on the type of knowledge that is available to them.
IT managers’ knowledge of their IT outsourcing decision can be a boon or a bane depending on the type of knowledge.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how IT managers make IT outsourcing decisions and what role knowledge plays in this context.
the question how decision-makers’ overconfidence affects IT investment decisions.
the question of how to avoid IT investment failure by improving IT investment decisions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
knowledge is not always beneficial for decision-makers, as it can be a double-edged sword.
the more knowledge a decisionmaker has, the less likely he is to be overconfident.
knowledge can be a boon or bane at the very same time, depending on the knowledge source.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the quality of IT investment decision-making depends on the interplay of decision makers’ knowledge, overconfidence and the decision situation.
knowledge is a double-edged sword in IT investment decision-making and that managers should be aware of this.
IT managers’ overconfidence in their IT outsourcing decisions can be reduced by improving their experienced knowledge and their objective knowledge, but not by increasing their subjective knowledge.
The main takeaway from our work is that
organizations should carefully select and train IT managers for IT investments.
IT outsourcing decisions are not just a matter of knowledge, but also a matter of knowledge type.
organizations need to be aware of the fact that overconfidence in IT investments can be a double-edged sword.
